update.releaseNotes:
v1.5.0 - Settings are safe from a hidden database bug, and Start warns you before a risky overnight queue
- Fixed: a settings-persistence bug present since version 1.3.0. A setting changed after your first Start in an app session could fail to reach the bot, or be lost entirely if you closed the app before starting again -- the app and the bot now share a single settings database connection, so a changed setting always reaches the bot and survives closing the app. - Fixed: the bot now refuses to start rather than run on settings that do not match what UMA Auto+ just checked, or on a settings file it cannot verify is safe -- nothing is spent either way, and a damaged file can be restored from its last good backup the next time you open the app. - New: Start now warns you before a run queue about setup that can end a long run early (TP restore off, Reuse Last Launch Setup off, the accessibility repair permission missing, a short screen timeout, or notifications off), without ever blocking you from starting anyway. - New: presets for Wonder Acute and Nakayama Festa, in all four scenarios. The roster is now 300 presets across 74 trainee cards. - New: a plan check on the Racing Plan page that flags unrecognized races, wrong-turn races, double-booked turns, and back-to-back races the bot may not be able to run, before you start a career. - Improved: Carats for TP restore are now a separate setting, on by default, instead of always being spent once items run out; a lost connection mid-career is ridden out for up to 20 minutes with growing retry pauses instead of giving up quickly. - Fixed: settings import reports whether it actually succeeded, partly succeeded, or failed, and a failed profile import can no longer leave you with none.
